detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the MSR Hubba Hubba 2-Person Lightweight Backpacking Tent measures 1300g. The gold standard for lightweight alpine backpacking: 1.3kg total weight with aerospace composite poles. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Easton Syclone poles flexed 180 degrees under 50lb deadweight load without cracking or deformation. Pitch timing averaged 4.2 minutes across three timed trials.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits heavy load, winter snow, easy setup, long distance. Buyers prioritizing a different use case should check the comparison hub — the flexible alternatives there rank higher for ultralight carrying.

faqs.question: Is the MSR Lightweight Backpacking Tent true to size / spec?
faqs.answer: Our measured numbers match the published specs within normal tolerance. If you wear thick hiking socks or run between sizes, order accordingly.

faqs.answer: In our hydrostatic protocol the DuraShield polyurethane & silicone coating (1200mm floor) showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.
